name: dealership-connector
description: Dealership Connector — desktop app + background agent that routes a dealership's FB sessions out through its own IP.

scripts.flasher:test: node flasher/_test/qconnect-payload.test.js && node flasher/_test/safety.test.js && node flasher/_test/inject.test.js && node flasher/_test/pi-model.test.js && node flasher/_test/batch.test.js && node flasher/_test/ui-batch.test.js

//flasher: The flasher WRITE ENGINE is Raspberry Pi Imager (rpi-imager.exe) — an external native app, install: winget install RaspberryPiFoundation.RaspberryPiImager (or set RPI_IMAGER). We do NOT use etcher-sdk/@ronomon/direct-io: their O_DIRECT external buffers are blocked by Electron 32's V8 sandbox and buffered-IO verify is untrustworthy. The only native npm deps the flasher needs are drivelist (drive enumeration; N-API, loads under Electron) and @vscode/sudo-prompt (elevation). After npm install run: npx electron-rebuild -f -w drivelist. Pure modules (flasher/safety.js, flasher/inject.js) + their tests need none of these.
